summary: This bill establishes a grant program through the Department of Justice to incentivize states to create and maintain their own point-of-contact systems for firearm background checks, requiring these systems to verify the legality of sales, issue approval numbers within 10 days, and include an appeals process and reporting requirements.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on strengthening background check systems for firearm sales by incentivizing states to establish point-of-contact systems and requiring specific procedures for these checks. This directly aims to make gun sales more regulated and thus constitutes stricter gun rules.

The bill includes provisions for transferring information about denied firearm sales to state or local law enforcement for investigation and reporting on arrests resulting from such transfers. This directly supports stricter enforcement of laws related to firearm sales and potential criminal activity.
